assessment_files_period_valid.name: assessment_files_period_valid
assessment_files_period_valid.value: "assessment_files"."assessment_period_start" IS NULL OR "assessment_files"."assessment_period_end" IS NULL OR "assessment_files"."assessment_period_start" <= "assessment_files"."assessment_period_end"

assessment_files_grade_range.name: assessment_files_grade_range
assessment_files_grade_range.value: ("assessment_files"."current_civil_service_grade" IS NULL OR "assessment_files"."current_civil_service_grade" BETWEEN 1 AND 9) AND ("assessment_files"."requested_civil_service_grade" IS NULL OR "assessment_files"."requested_civil_service_grade" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)

assessments_valid_period.name: assessments_valid_period
assessments_valid_period.value: "assessments"."period_start" IS NULL OR "assessments"."period_end" IS NULL OR "assessments"."period_start" <= "assessments"."period_end"
